fusions.name: Barbed Catch
fusions.desc: A barbed lash at an enemy up to 6 tiles away deals 4 damage, up to 1.3 times that at maximum range, makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snagging Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps the barbs around you, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Drag Line
fusions.desc: Lays a 6-tile barbed line ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Barb Set Deep
fusions.desc: Against a target carrying your afflictions, your damage rises by 10%.
